description: Soft-delete an API key (DELETE /v1/api_key/:id). Destructive. URL Signing keys are refused — delete those in the dashboard. Revoking the key that backs this hosted MCP connection also drops the OAuth grant (next live call returns 401). Pass dry_run=true to preview. Requires AudioDN OAuth sign-in (call adn_sign_in or complete account login first).
name: adn_revoke_api_key
